job.goal: Show how Orinovate turns a CAD file into a finished, production-grade part on demand.

scenes.brief: Orinovate wordmark cold-open on a clean kinetic-light canvas.
The instant-quote flow: upload a CAD file and get pricing back in seconds.
The capabilities view: CNC machining, 3D printing, sheet metal and laser sintering in one platform.
Guided multi-step demo of placing an order and tracking the part from production to delivery.
Animated stat card: production-grade parts shipped on demand from Taiwan.
Closing CTA card with the Orinovate wordmark and the next step.

beats.text: Orinovate turns your CAD file into a finished part.
Upload your design. Get an instant quote back in seconds.
CNC, 3D printing, sheet metal — production-grade, on demand.
Place the order. Track every part from the floor to your door.
Thousands of precision parts, shipped straight from Taiwan.
Make your part today at orinovate.com.
